subject: 리딩파워 유형편 완성
title: Ex02
fullPassage: On my first day in the Emergency Center, I was about to drink my coffee when the first call came. I quickly picked up the line, “9-1-1.” My voice was trembling and my heart was racing. A woman cried, “My husband’s not breathing!” I instructed her to begin CPR. I was trying to be as steady as I could, but I was shaking. The situation was absolutely critical. While she was performing CPR, I immediately notified the nearby hospital. After a few tense moments, she came back on the line and shouted, “Where’s the ambulance?” I replied, “It’s getting there as quickly as it can.”
